info.name: e_season API
info.description:
Sri Lanka Railways season-ticket backend.

Flow: Request OTP -> Verify OTP -> Register (multipart) -> Staff verification (officer for government passengers, then station staff) -> Create application -> Officer approval (government) -> Pay (sandbox) -> Scan QR.

Run folders top-down. Tokens and IDs are saved to collection variables by test scripts. Staff passwords come from `npm run db:seed`.

After success the password is NewPassw0rd#1. Run "Change password (restore)" to revert.
Upload at least one corrected image. Returns 409 not_rejected unless the account was rejected.
